Package com.datastax.driver.core

Class LoggingMonotonicTimestampGenerator

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.datastax.driver.core.AbstractMonotonicTimestampGenerator
      • com.datastax.driver.core.LoggingMonotonicTimestampGenerator
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    TimestampGenerator
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    AtomicMonotonicTimestampGenerator, ThreadLocalMonotonicTimestampGenerator
    public abstract class LoggingMonotonicTimestampGenerator
extends AbstractMonotonicTimestampGenerator
    A monotonic timestamp generator that logs warnings when timestamps drift in the future (see this class's constructors and onDrift(long, long) for more information).

    • Method Detail

      • onDrift

        protected void onDrift​(long currentTick,
                       long lastTimestamp)
        Called when generated timestamps drift into the future compared to the underlying clock (in other words, if lastTimestamp >= currentTick).

        This could happen if timestamps are requested faster than the clock granularity, or on a clock skew (for example because of a leap second).

        This implementation logs a warning at regular intervals when timestamps drift more than a specified threshold in the future. These messages are emitted at WARN level in the category com.datastax.driver.core.TimestampGenerator.

        Specified by:
        onDrift in class AbstractMonotonicTimestampGenerator
        Parameters:
        currentTick - the current clock tick.
        lastTimestamp - the last timestamp that was generated.
